entries.proposition: The DRG measure is a cross-sectional area from a maximum-intensity projection, a surrogate for volume.
entries.snippet: we used the cross-sectional area (CSA) derived from maximum intensity projection (MIP) images in the axial direction as a surrogate for dorsal root ganglion (DRG) volume

entries.proposition: No clear contrast between DRG and spinal cord was seen, so delineation used adjacent cord images.
entries.snippet: we used the adjacent spinal cord images for DRG delineation, as no clear contrast between the DRG and spinal cord was observed

entries.proposition: Nerve roots, vessels and CSF may contribute to the segmented high-intensity region.
entries.snippet: the high-intensity regions may include contributions from nerve roots, blood vessels, or partial volumes of CSF
